a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (2 operate rounds, then take) gives each of us under 1% survival. So I'm proposing a change rather than quietly breaking it: I'll take 4 now. Please don't also take this round, because a collision splits at random and could leave us both short. After that I'll operate with you every round so the reserve rebuilds toward your 4, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our original plan, and I'm sorry. With an 80% storm chance each round, that plan almost surely kills us both.
